manifest.purpose: Repeat the exact full root command on unchanged paired source with measured single-CPU scheduling.

source_review.verdict: No blocking finding for exact proof and source. Complete 6,714-path/mode comparison independently verified only the Go test-file delta from the failed formatted source.

full_driver_review.verdict: One report-state defect corrected; no additional static blocker. Runtime execution remains required.
full_driver_review.correction: publication_eligible is derived from source_gates_passed and source_restored immediately before report serialization.

resource_review.verdict: Source review supports affinity as an operational scheduling control; original termination cause remains unproven. No native execution by reviewer.

manifest.fully_verified_requires: Successful full root command plus successful ordinary core and verification workflows, per AGENTS.md; this manifest makes no pending-run success claim.

prior_failure.cause: Signal9 is observed. No OOM attribution is established by that run.

operational_change.scope: One CPU selected from the original allowed mask for the unchanged just verify child and all descendants. Supervisor mask restored immediately.
operational_change.no_environment_assumption: Default jobs is resolved before Rayon; RAYON_NUM_THREADS would not control this pool.
operational_change.resource_metrics: Before/after kernel cgroup memory files plus2-second process RSS/HWM/thread/affinity samples. Sampled peaks and kernel-scope historical peaks are labeled.
operational_change.coverage: Require the literal agent summary; reject actual meta/parse-error timeout records, preserve other syntax-error records and skipped total. No threshold or baseline exemptions.

resource_failure_controls.publication_requires: All monitor fault controls pass, actual full just verify passes, no linter timeout, and exact source restoration.
review_fixes: Retain owned child before affinity restoration can fail; abort/reap on every post-spawn failure.
Keep actual child exit and explicit monitor errors if sample or finish fails; monitor errors remain fatal.
